data.title: A robotic arm on a Texas rig picks up 30-foot joints of pipe weighing 2,000 pounds and makes the connection on a floor where a third of all drilling injuries have happened, and the floorhand who used to stand there now works a touchscreen while Houston steers from across the state
data.description: ExxonMobil operates more than 30 drilling rigs across the Permian, and two of those now move pipe with robotic arms while a contractor works a touchscreen
